page_title: RSO 2-2 ALM | Real Sociedad v Almeria 14/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+4' Largie Ramazani (Almeria) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
90+4' The game is interrupted. Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
90+2' What a huge chance for Largie Ramazani (Almeria). He collects a precise pass inside the box and slices a shot that goes a whisker wide of the left post.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Substitution. Jon Pacheco (Real Sociedad) on for Arsen Zakharyan.
88' 2 - 2 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Adrian Embarba (Almeria) low into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Alex Remiro no chance!
88' Adrian Embarba (Almeria) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
86' We have witnessed a sending-off! Igor Zubeldia (Real Sociedad) is given a red card for his dangerous challenge. Isidro Diaz de Mera's decision is final.
86' Igor Zubeldia (Real Sociedad) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. PENALTY AWARDED to Almeria!

83' Choco Lozano (Almeria) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Isidro Diaz de Mera with no other option than to blow for a foul.
80' The referee blows his whistle as Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad) was too aggressive in his challenge.
78' Substitution. Mikel Oyarzabal walks off the pitch and Andre Silva (Real Sociedad) comes on as a substitute.
75' Isidro Diaz de Mera shows a yellow card to Robin Le Normand (Real Sociedad), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
74' Pepe Mel has decided to substitute Dion Lopy and he is replaced by Iddrisu Baba (Almeria).
73' That was close by Largie Ramazani (Almeria)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the right post.
70' That's the end of the game for Leo Baptistao, who is replaced by Choco Lozano (Almeria).
70' Imanol Alguacil prepares a substitution. Sheraldo Becker is replaced by Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad).
70' Here is a change. Ander Barrenetxea is going off and Imanol Alguacil gives the last tactical orders to Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad).
69' Hamari Traore (Real Sociedad) was too forceful with his tackle and Isidro Diaz de Mera interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
68' Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Isidro Diaz de Mera no option but to blow his whistle.
64' Robin Le Normand (Real Sociedad) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
61' Isidro Diaz de Mera sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
60' The Real Sociedad players halt their celebrations as referee Isidro Diaz de Mera makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
59' 2 - 1 Goal! Sheraldo Becker feeds Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad), who taps the ball into an empty net. He makes it 2:1.
57' Almeria take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
53' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar.
49' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
46' Dion Lopy (Almeria) commits a rough foul. Isidro Diaz de Mera stops the game and makes a call.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Pepe Mel gives a chance to Largie Ramazani (Almeria) and Luka Romero is off.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the right post.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
44' Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad) picks up a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot goalwards that crashes against the bar. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
43' Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
42' Mikel Merino (Real Sociedad) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball.
40' Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) gets to the rebound inside the box and shoots to the bottom right corner, but his sidefooter is blocked by an alert Luis Maximiano. What a save!
40' Great save! Javi Galan (Real Sociedad) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom right corner was brilliantly saved by Luis Maximiano.
36' Isidro Diaz de Mera shows the yellow card to Luka Romero (Almeria) for a heavy challenge.
34' Real Sociedad have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

32' 1 - 1 Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) meets a perfect cross from Javi Galan deep inside the box and controls it with a nice first touch. He produces an accurate strike inside the left post. It's 1:1.

30' 0 - 1 Adrian Embarba (Almeria) scores a goal after nicely controlling a pass and unleashing a powerful close-range shot into the bottom right corner. The keeper couldn't do anything to stop this wonderful effort.
29' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Almeria, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
28' Isidro Diaz de Mera blows his whistle for a foul after Hamari Traore (Real Sociedad) hacks down one of his opponents.
25' Isidro Diaz de Mera couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Dion Lopy (Almeria) and blew his whistle.
20' Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
16' Mikel Merino (Real Sociedad) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar.
13' Javi Galan (Real Sociedad) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
12' Robin Le Normand (Real Sociedad) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the corner, but his fine header towards the top left corner is brilliantly saved by the diving goalkeeper.
11' The ball is out of play and Real Sociedad manage to earn a corner.
10' Real Sociedad can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
9' Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar.
7' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Isidro Diaz de Mera saw the whole situation.

4' Mikel Merino (Real Sociedad) comes close to scoring! He gets the ball inside the box from the resulting corner but his effort goes narrowly wide of the left post. This should be a big warning for the defence.
4' Good work from Real Sociedad as they win a corner.
2' Leo Baptistao (Almeria) is caught offside!
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Almeria will take the kick-off.
Isidro Diaz de Mera is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
